name: Titanium Unlimited WebP Optimizer
author: Admin Plugins

sections.description:
Titanium Unlimited WebP Optimizer is a local WordPress image optimization plugin. Image conversion runs on your server; there are no remote image uploads, API keys, credits, or plugin-side image limits.

Free includes:

  • Unlimited local WebP conversion for JPG and PNG Media Library images.
  • Automatic WebP creation for new uploads.
  • Bulk background queue through WordPress cron, with pause, resume, stop, progress, elapsed time, and live refresh.
  • 1 Click Full Optimization for beginners plus advanced manual tasks.
  • Full image status database, new-upload checks, missing-only conversion, full rebuilds, and failed-item retry.
  • WebP generation for registered WordPress sizes.
  • Missing format, missing WordPress size, metadata, and repairable source-reference diagnostics.
  • Media Library WebP status column and single-image refresh action.
  • Native WebP handling without .webp.webp duplicates.
  • Safe original-image fallback delivery and optional frontend HTML image URL replacement where safe.
  • Unregistered uploads manager with ignore and restore.
  • Custom image size manager, server capability checks, manual cache purge, dashboard totals, and clean uninstall option.

Pro adds:

  • AVIF generation and delivery, including native WebP to AVIF and native AVIF to WebP fallback sidecars.
  • Smart AVIF / WebP / original fallback delivery.
  • Regenerate missing WordPress image sizes.
  • Auto-fix repairable source references during safe queue tasks.
  • Website Optimization suite: Layout Shift Fixer, oversized delivery scan, LCP / hero image warnings, responsive delivery report, broken image scan, image SEO audit, WooCommerce image scan, social preview checker, and Smart Upload Guard.
  • Elementor and inline CSS background image rewrite.
  • Uploads, theme, plugin, and custom-folder scans.
  • Unregistered uploads import, optimization without Media Library import, and native WebP uploads to AVIF sidecars.
  • Advanced exclusions, max-size rules, daily/weekly/monthly scheduled maintenance, and WP-CLI commands.
  • Restore-safe cleanup reports for old resized sidecars and duplicate source candidates with 90-day quarantine, one-by-one restore, and Restore all.

External pricing, checkout, licensing, account, and update services are documented below.

External services

This plugin processes images locally on your WordPress server. It connects to external services only for admin pricing, checkout, licensing, account management, and software-update services described here.

AdminPlugins pricing API

The plugin can contact the AdminPlugins pricing API to load public plan prices, license limits, discount state, and checkout URLs shown on the Upgrade / pricing page. The request is made from the WordPress admin area only when no valid 24-hour local pricing cache exists or when the cache has expired. The plugin sends a server-side HTTP GET request to https://adminplugins.com/wp-json/awo-freemius/v1/pricing and may use https://adminplugins.com/?rest_route=/awo-freemius/v1/pricing as a fallback. No image files, Media Library contents, conversion settings, users, passwords, license keys, or site URL are sent by these pricing requests.

Service provider: AdminPlugins. Terms: https://adminplugins.com/terms-and-conditions/ Privacy: https://adminplugins.com/privacy-policy/

Freemius SDK and Checkout

The plugin uses the Freemius SDK for optional Pro licensing, account management, software updates, and checkout. The Freemius Checkout JavaScript from https://checkout.freemius.com/js/v1/ is loaded only after an administrator clicks an Upgrade button. If the checkout script cannot load, the administrator is sent to the normal secure Freemius checkout URL. Freemius may receive licensing and site/account data when an administrator opts in, activates or manages a license, opens Freemius account/license screens, checks for updates, or starts checkout. Checkout data can include product ID, plan ID, pricing ID, selected license quantity, billing cycle, currency, active coupon code when supplied by the pricing API, and license key when upgrading an existing license.

Service provider: Freemius, Inc. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to WebP Optimizer in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Check the server status and start conversion.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my original images?

No. Original JPG and PNG files are kept. Native WebP uploads are treated as already optimized sources, and generated WebP files are created next to JPG/PNG originals.

Does this use an external API?

Image conversion runs locally on your own server using Imagick or GD. The admin Upgrade / pricing and licensing screens can connect to the external services documented below.

Is there an image limit?

No plugin-side image count limit is applied. Images are processed in safe batches to avoid server timeouts.

What file structure does it use?

The plugin creates files like image.jpg.webp and image.png.webp. Native WebP uploads are not converted into image.webp.webp.

Background optimization queue with live progress, completed task statistics, and a detailed result breakdown.
Beginner-friendly one-click full optimization with server-load control and confirmation for long-running tasks.
Advanced queue modes for database checks, new uploads, missing image sizes, targeted conversion, retries, and complete rebuilds.
Unregistered uploads manager with discovered and ignored files, Media Library diagnostics, and recent background results.
Website Optimization overview and Layout Shift Fixer for detecting images missing width and height attributes.
Oversized Image Delivery Scanner with browser-rendered page checks, scan totals, and affected-image review.
Image Site Report with selectable checks for performance, broken images, image SEO, product images, social previews, and large uploads.
Image conversion, delivery, and size settings with quality controls, automatic processing, upload resizing, and registered image sizes.
Advanced optimization and maintenance tools for background rewriting, folder scans, exclusions, scheduling, command-line tasks, and duplicate review.
